title: H11: GroupInfo with embedded ratchet_tree refused
description: protocol-06 §5.6 says GroupInfo is served without an embedded ratchet_tree, but a partial GroupInfo with ratchet_tree_presence=present was signed over one. The hub refuses commits whose GroupInfo embeds the tree and always serves GroupInfo without it plus RatchetTreeOption::full. wg item filed. Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
